storage.sure_rows: {n} entries, {rec} recordings, and their stage records and reruns are deleted from this computer. This cannot be undone.
storage.sure_recordings: {n} recording files are deleted from this computer; the text stays. This cannot be undone.
storage.sure_stages: {n} stage records are deleted; every entry keeps its text. This cannot be undone.

storage.sure_stats: Every number on the Statistics page goes back to zero; the history is not deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage.usage_note: Deleting affects this computer only; the files in the backup folder are not touched.
storage.rows_off: Nothing of a dictation is kept once it ends: the History page stays empty, the Dictionary makes no suggestions, nothing can be retried or processed again, and a correction read back after insertion has nowhere to go. Recordings, stage records and reruns are not kept either.
storage.recordings_on: The audio of every dictation; needed to listen again and to process again.
storage.recordings_off: No audio is kept; a failed or cancelled dictation is still listed in History but cannot be processed again.
storage.stages_on: What each stage turned the text into. After the retention the entry keeps its text only.
storage.stages_off: Later dictations do not record what each stage did: History shows one processing step in between, and the last run on the Profiles page has no stage contents.
storage.stats_on: The numbers on the Statistics page, added up by the hour; they do not expire.
storage.stats_off: Later dictations are not counted; the Statistics page shows what was counted before.
storage.keep_note: 0 days keeps them forever; expired ones are cleared once a day. Switching to Do not keep deletes nothing that exists; it goes when it expires or is deleted above.

general.read_back_on: A few seconds after the text is put in, and again when the next recording starts, the app reads the field and keeps your changes to the text as the dictation's final text.
general.read_back_off: After the text is put in, the field is not read; your changes to it are not kept.
general.read_back_info: The field is read through Accessibility. Only the lines that match the inserted text are kept, never the whole field. A field that gives no text (a terminal), one that has been sent, or a text that was replaced rather than corrected leaves the record as it was. A profile with the translation module is not read back. The Dictionary page suggests terms from the kept changes.
general.dev_help: Switches for looking into how the app works. Each one writes more to the log; all are off by default.

general.log_read_back_off: The log records only each read-back's outcome, never the text.

general.llm_idle_unload_info: The next rewrite after a release waits for the model to load again. Never released, the model stays in memory, several GB depending on the model.

general.llm_preload_off_info: The first dictation after an idle unload waits for the load.

backup.auto_info: Only adds and updates; nothing already in the folder is deleted.
backup.auto_off: The folder is written only when Back up now is pressed.
backup.status_never_detail: Nothing has been backed up to this folder yet.
backup.import_folder_help: Merges the records other devices backed up to a folder; nothing on this device is replaced.
backup.folder_note: Only what changed is written into the same folder, and only this device's data.
backup.folder_info: The folder holds plain text files and recordings, so you can sync it or copy it elsewhere with your own tools.
backup.devices_note: After records are imported, the other devices are listed here.
backup.devices_info_before: The totals of all devices are in
backup.remove_body: The {n} history rows of "{name}" on this device, their recordings and its statistics are deleted. Records of other devices, and what is in records files and the folder, are not affected.
backup.section.profiles_help: Names, what they apply to, the engines chosen, prompt additions, examples
backup.section.providers_help: Engines and their parameters. API keys are not included
backup.section.recording_help: Shortcuts, hold and double-tap times, maximum length, automatic end
backup.section.insertion_help: Default method, keep on the clipboard, per application
backup.section.general_help: Interface language, retention days, context switches, typing speed, timeouts and retries
backup.section.appearance_help: Floating widget size and resting look, statistics page layout
backup.export_lead.settings: Choose the items that go into the settings file.
backup.export_lead.content: Choose the items that go into the content file.
backup.export_lead.records: Saves the records of every device on this computer as one records file (.arcvox).
backup.export_note.settings: The settings file is plain text and not encrypted. The microphone, the fixed display and window positions are not written.
backup.export_note.content: The content file is plain text and not encrypted. API keys, the values of extra headers and the folder of a model file are not written.
backup.export_note.records: The records file is not encrypted.
backup.import_lead.settings: The ticked items replace this device's current settings. The settings before the change are kept as a copy.
backup.import_lead.content: The ticked items replace this device's current content. The content before the change is kept as a copy.
backup.import_lead.records: The records in the file or folder are merged into this device. Nothing here is replaced or deleted, and importing the same records again changes nothing.
backup.imported_none: The file has none of the ticked items.
backup.note.needs_key: Engine "{engine}" needs its API key entered again
backup.note.needs_key_detail: Keys are not written to content files.
backup.note.engine_replaced_asr: Profile "{profile}" named an engine that cannot recognise speech; it follows the default engine now
backup.note.engine_replaced_llm: Profile "{profile}" named an engine that cannot rewrite; it follows the default engine now
backup.note.default_engine_reset_asr: The file named a default speech engine that is not here; the shipped one is set
backup.note.default_engine_reset_llm: The file named a default rewriting engine that is not here; the shipped one is set
backup.note.engine_unavailable: Engine "{engine}" cannot run on this computer
backup.note.unknown_section: The file has an item "{name}" that this version does not know; it was left out
backup.note.apps: The imported items name {n} applications that are not installed here: {names}
backup.note.apps_detail: They take effect once the application is installed.
backup.cat.history_help: {n} rows. Dictated text and application names, not encrypted
backup.cat.stats_help: Numbers, application names and profiles only; no dictated text
backup.cat.recordings_warn: Recordings take much more space than the other items. Check that the destination has enough room first.
backup.cat.settings_help: Shortcuts and recording, insertion method, general settings, appearance
backup.cat.content_help: Profiles, engines, dictionary, base prompt. API keys are not included
backup.items_lead: Choose what is backed up to the folder. The folder is only added to and updated; nothing already there is deleted.
backup.items_warn: With recordings included, the folder grows with every dictation. Recordings this device removes by its retention stay in the folder.
backup.ib_cells: Statistics: {n} hourly buckets added or updated
backup.ib_missing: {n} rows name a recording that is not in the source
backup.ib_bad: {n} lines could not be read and were skipped
backup.ib_expiring_detail: {n} of the added rows are older and will be removed by the next daily cleanup. Statistics are not affected.
backup.recreate: Create the folder again when it is missing
backup.recreate_on: When the folder cannot be found it is created again at the same place and this device's data is backed up to it in full.
backup.recreate_off: When the folder cannot be found, automatic backup pauses and tells you.
backup.folder_missing_detail: The folder may have been deleted or moved, or its disk is not connected.
backup.folder_not_writable_detail: This folder does not allow writing at the moment.
backup.folder_blocked_detail: The system's privacy settings do not allow access to this folder.
backup.create_failed: The folder could not be created
backup.failed_missing: The folder was not found at the last backup
backup.failed_not_writable: The folder could not be written at the last backup
backup.failed_blocked: The system did not allow access to the folder at the last backup
general.widget_fade_help: After resting a while the widget turns faint. It comes back when a dictation begins or the pointer is over it.
general.widget_fade_off: The widget stays as it is while resting.
general.preview_idle_hidden: The widget is hidden while idle, so nothing is shown.
general.preview_raw: um i think we can ship this feature first and then look at the feedback
general.preview_refined: I think we can ship this feature first, then look at the feedback.

flow.panel.failed: This step failed and the text went on as it was: {message}
flow.record_recordings: Recordings and retention are in General
flow.trim_help: Silence before and after the speech is removed before recognition; pauses inside stay.
flow.asr_hint: Tell the recognition engine the dictionary terms
flow.asr_hint_help_before: The engine prefers these spellings when it hears them, but does not guarantee them; the sure replacement is in
flow.llm_rules_info: All of these are hints to the model; how closely it follows them depends on the model.
flow.llm_terms_help_before: The model is told how these terms are written; the sure replacement is in
flow.llm_title_help: So the model knows which application you are speaking in.
flow.llm_short: Fall back when the output is too short
flow.llm_short_help: Shorter than half the input counts as a failure and the recognised text is used.
flow.manage_none_selected: Tick the profiles to delete together.
flow.manage_delete_body: {names}. Applications that used them fall back to the default profile. The history is not affected.
flow.manage_default_locked: The default profile cannot be deleted.
flow.opencc_engine_before: Converted locally with the OpenCC dictionaries, no network. The licence is on the
flow.script_punct_help: Swaps “ ” and 「 」 along with the characters.
flow.reset_body: The whole profile goes back to the "{preset}" template: engines, script conversions, switches, main language, writing style, examples and the applications it applies to. The name stays.
flow.reset_missing_body: The template this profile was made from is not in this version. It can be reset to the "Casual" template instead: the whole profile, engines and applications included, goes back to casual. The name stays.
flow.manage_preset_hint: Made from the "{preset}" template; a reset returns to it.
flow.panel.insert_outcome.copied: copied to the clipboard, nothing put into the application
flow.panel.insert_outcome.secure_input: shown on the panel, the field was a secure input
flow.panel.insert_outcome.app_changed: shown on the panel, the front application had changed
flow.panel.insert_outcome.not_trusted: shown on the panel, no accessibility permission
flow.panel.insert_outcome.clipboard_fail: shown on the panel, the clipboard refused the text
flow.panel.insert_outcome.empty_text: nothing to put in, the text was empty
flow.rule.trailing_stop_on: A full stop after the last character is removed; full stops between sentences stay.
flow.rule.trailing_stop_off: A full stop after the last character stays as the rewrite wrote it.
flow.rule.question_mark: Question mark after 嗎 or 呢
flow.rule.question_mark_on: A text ending in 嗎 or 呢 with no mark gets a question mark.
flow.rule.question_mark_off: The mark at the end stays as the rewrite wrote it.
flow.rule.spacing_on: One space goes between a CJK character and an ASCII letter or digit; existing spaces stay.
flow.rule.spacing_off: Spacing between CJK and ASCII is as the rewrite left it.
flow.rule.punctuation_width_on: A half-width , . ? ! : ; after a CJK character becomes full-width; decimal points and addresses stay.
flow.rule.punctuation_width_off: The width of punctuation is as the rewrite left it.
flow.rule.question_mark_inside: Question marks after 嗎 or 呢 inside the text
flow.rule.question_mark_inside_on: A full stop right after 嗎 or 呢 inside the text becomes a question mark; a comma after them stays.
flow.rule.question_mark_inside_off: Full stops inside the text are as the rewrite left them.
flow.enable_help: An enabled module sits at its fixed stage position.
flow.module.llm_help: A language model turns the recognised text into text ready to paste
flow.module.rules_help: Dictionary replacements, and the punctuation and spacing rules
flow.module.translate_help: Turns the tidied text into another language or style
flow.disable_info: A disabled module keeps its settings; enabling it brings them back.
flow.disable_llm_help: The recognised text is no longer rewritten.
flow.disable_rules_help: Dictionary aliases are no longer replaced, snippets no longer inserted, and the text rules no longer applied.
flow.cell.capture_trimmed: Recorded {secs} s, {removed} s of silence removed
flow.translate_info: The target can be a language or a style; whether the engine can do it is up to the engine. With this module enabled, the text put in is not read back.
flow.translate_target_help: The tidied text is turned into this language or style before it is put in.
flow.translate_custom_help: Written into the prompt as it is, for example 文言文, 古典英文, 台語漢字.
flow.translate_addition_help: Added after the translation's base prompt and the target; leave it empty to use the base prompt only.
flow.follow_rewrite_help: Now {name}; follows the rewrite stage. Pick an engine here to translate with another one. When the translation fails, the untranslated text is put in.
flow.disable_translate_help: The text is no longer translated.
engines.quality: Score each engine's output against corrected texts:
quality.title: Quality test
quality.description: Scores engines on kept recordings and corrected texts: word and punctuation error rates.
quality.data_info: Recognition is scored against the corrected transcript; a transcript nobody corrected counts as right. Rewrite and whole are scored against the final text.
quality.limit_help: Over the limit, rows are spread over the categories, the same rows each time; 0 takes every row.
quality.available_help: {n} with a recording in the period, {heard} with a corrected transcript.
quality.stage_help: Recognition: audio to text. Rewrite: the corrected transcript through every stage after recognition. Whole: audio through the whole profile.
quality.profile_help: Prompt, writing style, modules and dictionary follow this profile.
quality.engines_full_help: The whole stage runs one speech engine and one rewrite engine; none chosen means the profile's.
quality.warning: Do not dictate while the test runs.
quality.marks: Punctuation, written too many and left out
quality.mark.question: Question mark
quality.category.question: Question
quality.compare.title: Compare two runs
quality.compare.description: What changed between two runs on the same rows; only rows in both count.
quality.compare.unmatched: {n} rows are in one run only.
quality.compare.same_stage: The second list holds the results of the same stage.
quality.compare.none: No rows are in both runs.
error.quality_no_run: There is no run to save.
error.quality_bad_report: The result file could not be read: {message}
error.file_unreadable: The file could not be read: {message}
error.set_invalid: The set file is not in the expected form: {message}
welcome.engines.title: Choose the engines
welcome.engines.desc: Dictation has two parts: recognition turns speech into text, rewriting tidies the text. Pick one model for each and download them.
welcome.apple.title: Apple dictation + Apple Intelligence
welcome.apple.desc: Recognition by macOS dictation, rewriting by this Mac's Apple Intelligence. No model to download.
welcome.apple.preparing: The system is preparing Apple Intelligence
welcome.later: Set up a network service or another model on the Engines page later
welcome.later_note: Dictation does not work after the guide until an engine is set up on the Engines page.
welcome.permissions.title: Allow the permissions
welcome.permissions.desc: Two macOS permissions. The state here updates once they are granted.
welcome.try.title: Try a sentence
welcome.try.desc: Hold any shortcut and speak; letting go ends it. The text goes into the active text field, and this page shows a copy.
welcome.keys_note: Can be changed in the settings later
welcome.result.no_engine: No engine can run yet; set one up on the Engines page after finishing.
welcome.result.waiting_models: The models are still downloading, {done} / {total}. Speak once they are there.
welcome.result.ready: Hold a shortcut and say a sentence.
welcome.launch_on: Arcvox starts when you log in to macOS and waits in the menu bar.
welcome.launch_off: Arcvox does not start when you log in to macOS.
